item.title: Rapides Registrar of Voters returns to courthouse after renovations
item.description: The Rapides Parish Registrar of Voters Office has returned to its longtime location inside the Rapides Parish Courthouse after operating from a temporary office for more than a year. Registrar of Voters Sandra Bonnette announced that the office resumed operations at the courthouse on March 11, 2026, following the completion of renovations.
